propositions: Pass-1 finders flag plan-vs-code discrepancies during execution review that are actually expected outcomes of completed directed work, falsely blocking correct tickets from closing
A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` is set by the verifier to check whether code as-is satisfies the plan's directed end state
Pass-2 veto drops findings with reason="veto:plan-goal-satisfied" only when execution_review=True AND the answer is definite yes AND the finding is code-grounded
The veto is cohort-restricted to registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED {E4, G1G2, A1, G6, asserted-capability}; non-grounded findings are forced to na in the orchestrator wrapper
Planning-phase reviews and code-review calls are unaffected (execution_review kwarg defaults False and is not carried by base/code-review models)
